fact: The FDSI director general says teams covered the whole country, with the Registre Social Unifié holding 977,610 households and 4,860,075 individuals, and the minister calls it the single entry point of national social protection programmes.

The FDSI director general says RSU data has served the Guichet Choc Alimentaire project with ANIES and the IMF, UNICEF's follow-up of malnourished children, and SOS Villages d'Enfants' family strengthening project.
